claims.claim: Unifies non-reasoning and reasoning modes in a single model
claims.quote: into a single model, allowing users to experience both modes within one model.
With the upcoming era of agentic AI in mind, EXAONE 4.0 introduces agentic tool use—a core capability for this paradigm—and further advances reasoning abilities.

claims.claim: Adds Spanish language support alongside English and Korean
claims.quote: the EXAONE 4.0 officially add Spanish to its supported languages, expanding beyond its previous bilingual support for English and Korean.

claims.claim: Significantly more pretraining tokens to bolster world knowledge
claims.quote: Compared to previous versions of EXAONE, the number of tokens used during pretraining is significantly increased to bolster world knowledge.

claims.claim: Curation of specialized STEM-domain training data
claims.quote: curating training data from specialized domains such as STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields plays important role on downstream tasks.
the extension of maximum context length of the model to 128K tokens enables handling of various tasks based on significantly longer contexts

claims.claim: Hybrid global/local (sliding window) attention to reduce compute with minimal degradation
claims.quote: a hybrid architecture combining global attention and local attention is adopted. This approach minimizes performance degradation while reducing computational costs
two sizes: a mid-size 32B model optimized for high performance, and a small-size 1.2B model designed for on-device applications.

claims.claim: Superior performance vs open-weight models in class, competitive with frontier models
claims.quote: demonstrates superior performance compared to open-weight models in its class and remains competitive even against frontier-class models.
